column4: same simple name, different class: the dictlang PackedText is a FixedLexicon snapshot with a sha256 (100 LOC), the donor's an immutable long[] of token ids (40 LOC). com.synexia synexia-interned-language (MappedLexiconArtifact, IndexStringPoolArtifact, JniMindexStringBridge, PanLex/Translation importers) is a different lineage and carries no TokenId / TokenRope / OverflowInterner / SharedSymbols: m3scale is the only live copy

both hold a token sequence: M3WordIdSequence maps token spans of a separator kind to int CWID lanes (start/end/wordId per token), M3PackedText holds packed 64-bit token ids with no spans; a bridge (M3WordIdSequence -> M3PackedText with a language id) is a later leaf
